messages:
Amanda: FYI we got an invoice from Zephyrus Cloud (INV-2026-214) but AP auto-match failed — no PO on file in the system. PDF attached: zephyrus_03.pdf. Can someone help with routing?
Felix: linking the invoice in the AP queue now. vendor name looks like 'Zephyrus Cloud Services' vs 'ZephyrusTech' — slight mismatch, could be why auto-match failed.
Nina: any PO number on the vendor PDF? sometimes OCR turns zeros into O's.
Amanda: OCR snippet:
```
Vendor: Zephyrus Cloud Services
Invoice: INV-2026-214
PO Number: PO: OOOO-TR
Total: $12,345.67
```
Looks like `OOOO-TR` which is wrong. The engineering team mentioned PO-7642 for cloud infra last month.
FinanceBot: Invoice INV-2026-214 received and queued. Auto-match: failed (reason: PO not found, OCR_confidence=0.42). Routing: paused.
Felix: @Nina can you check GL/cost center if this should be matched to PO-7642? If yes we can do a manual override.
Nina: Confirmed with eng-infra — this spend belongs to PO-7642 (cloud infra commit). GL code should be 4012-CloudOps. Approver is Michael.
Amanda: I uploaded a note to the invoice record and renamed the attachment to `INV-2026-214-PO7642.pdf`. Also added comment: `MATCH PO-7642` in the AP system.
ProcurementBot: Manual PO match request created: ticket FIN-3219. Assigned to AP team.
FinanceBot: Manual override detected: user Amanda requested MATCH PO-7642. Override queued for AP approver review.
Ryan: Confirming vendor identity — Zephyrus Cloud Services is the correct vendor (we use them for burst GPUs).
Michael: I see the manual match request. Quick check: one line item shows 50 extra compute hours vs expected — is that disputed?
Amanda: Reached out to vendor; they said a credit memo will be issued for the overage. Requested ETA 3 business days.
Michael: OK I'll hold payment for this invoice for up to 7 days pending the credit. If credit arrives, process normal payment.
Nina: Approved cost center 4012 and GL 4012-CloudOps. Marking approval in the AP queue.
FinanceBot: Invoice INV-2026-214 status updated: Held (reason: credit pending). Manual match applied: PO-7642. Next approver: Michael. JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3219
Felix: Thanks all — once credit memo is posted I'll update FIN-3219 and unhold payment.
Michael: :thumbsup: keep me posted, Amanda.
Amanda: Will do — vendor reply included their contact (acct@zephyruscloud.com). Saving thread and closing loop once credit posted.
